description: This Java class provides helper methods for serializing Java objects into JSON format using Google's Gson library. It includes methods to create customized Gson instances with specific type adapters and strategies for filtering response parameters, as well as methods for serializing objects to JSON strings.

classes.name: GoogleGsonSerializerHelper
classes.description: Helper class for serialization of Java objects into JSON using Google's Gson library, providing methods to customize Gson instances with various type adapters and strategies.

methods.name: createGsonBuilderForPartialResponseFiltering
methods.description: Creates a Gson instance with an inclusion strategy based on provided response parameters, filtering serialization accordingly.

methods.name: createGsonBuilderWithParameterExclusionSerializationStrategy
methods.description: Creates a Gson instance with an exclusion strategy based on supported and response parameters, throwing exception if unsupported parameters are requested.

methods.name: serializedJsonFrom
methods.description: Serializes one or more data objects into a JSON string using the provided Gson serializer.

methods.name: createSimpleGson
methods.description: Creates a default Gson instance with registered type adapters.

methods.name: createGsonBuilder
methods.description: Creates a GsonBuilder instance with registered type adapters.

methods.name: registerTypeAdapters
methods.description: Registers specific type adapters for various Java date/time classes and custom types to the provided GsonBuilder.
